name: bench-sessions
description: Opens scoped agent task sessions and shows what each one is doing, from the bench collector.

commands.title: Bench: Start Task Session in a New Window
Bench: Link This Window's Task to a Plan
Bench: Open Session in the Console
Bench: Install Recording Hooks in This Folder

benchSessions.collectorUrl.description: Where bench-collector listens. Pinned rather than discovered: the same address is written into every instrumented repository's .claude/settings.local.json.

benchSessions.consoleUrl.description: Base URL of the DewFlow console that mounts the Benchmarking section, e.g. https://localhost:7443. Leave empty to disable 'Open in the Console'.

benchSessions.benchExecutable.description: Full path to bench.exe, used by 'Install Recording Hooks'. Leave empty to be asked once.

benchSessions.agentCommand.description: The command a task terminal runs. Set to an empty string to open the terminal without launching anything.

benchSessions.refreshSeconds.description: How often the session list and the status bar re-read the collector. Zero disables polling; the refresh button always works.
